issues.description: Method Stock.add(String): The UML in problem_statement.md (class Stock) declares add(String) with return type void, while both the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) and the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) declare public int add(String). This mismatch about the return type of Stock.add(String) can confuse students about the expected signature and the meaning of the method's return value (the template/solution use the int to indicate the new quantity or failure).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare +add(String): int to match the template and solution implementations (or, less preferred, change the template/solution to void and adjust all uses). Prefer updating the UML to +add(String): int so the specification matches the provided code and explains the return value semantics (new quantity or -1 on failure).
